title: The Night Shift (Part 2)
description: We rejoin the Pinewood Estates Neighborhood Watch live on Snazzie FM. Glenda has flagged Darnell as the mole and ordered his retirement. Darnell is now hiding in the third bin, the station itself has been declared the Watch's new safe house, and the only way Barry can clear his name is to take a codename. The harder anyone tries to opt out, the deeper they're enrolled.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And we're back on Snazzie FM, still doing our part with the Pinewood Estates Neighborhood Watch. <p:0.3> When we left off, Captain Glenda had, ah, retired a volunteer.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: She did not retire him, Ronnie. She told him to climb into a recycling bin.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: I'm IN the bin. <p:0.3> Okay? I'm calling you from inside the third bin. I want that on the record.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: And doesn't he sound calmer already, sweetheart. The bin does that.

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Ooh, I'm in a bin too! Solidarity! <p:0.3> Wait, which one was mine?

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: You're in the second bin, Linda. That's just garbage.

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Oh. <p:0.3> It's cozy though.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Glenda, so the matter's settled? Darnell retires, everybody goes home?

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Oh, no, sweetheart. A mole never works alone. <p:0.3> We've traced his handler. The signal goes straight to your studio.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: [question-en] Our studio?

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Snazzie FM is the safe house now.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: You can't just DECLARE a radio station a safe house, Winston!

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Already did. There's a van in your lot. <p:0.3> Lights off. Lovely paint job. Ask yourself why it's idling.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now that's a neighbor watching over a broadcast. Touching, Barry.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It is NOT touching. There's a van. Idling. In our lot.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: And we'll feel so much better once we know whose side you're on, Barry dear. <p:0.3> So we've issued you a codename. You're Nightingale Five.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I did not sign up for the Watch.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: That's what the handler would say.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Barry, don't argue, just take the codename. <p:0.3> I argued. I'm in a bin.

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Did Barry get a pretzel? I want Barry to get a pretzel.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: There's a pretzel taped under the soundboard, sweetheart. <p:0.3> Do not eat it unless the studio is compromised.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, there is a pretzel taped under MY soundboard.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That's craft services, Barry. Generous outfit.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: It is NOT craft services! Glenda told me that exact thing and now I live in a bin!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The van is at the door. <p:0.3> Ronnie, the van is at the studio door and it is knocking.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Then it's time for your extraction, Nightingale Five. <p:0.3> There's a bin behind the building. You know what to do.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I am not getting in a bin!

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: That's what I said!

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: The bin!

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Then he's the handler. Retire the station.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: [surprise-ah] You can't retire a STATION!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Well folks, that's our show, brought to you by neighbors just looking out for neighbors. <p:0.3> We'll be right back, if the studio's still here.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie. <p:0.3> Why are the studio lights off.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: The studio was a dead drop.
